What this album is

We Want a Chiefs Christmas is a 13-track holiday album (plus Jazz & Vault bonus tracks) created by Kansas City locals in partnership with Rogue Round Table. It’s our way of saying “thank you” to a community that always shows up when neighbors are struggling.

Why we made it

KC is overflowing with food drives and generosity — but frontline teams are still seeing critical gaps:

  • Fresh food arriving spoiled or unusable.
  • Pantries running out of meat, dairy, butter, or formula.
  • No soft foods for unhoused neighbors or folks without teeth.
  • School snack programs stretched past capacity.

This album turns KC fandom into flexible funding so partners can buy exactly what’s missing — in real time — and get it into homes the same day.

How it works

You donate once on GiveButter. Rogue Round Table uses those funds to support KC pantries, outreach teams, and emergency needs. As a thank-you, we send you the full digital album, including all bonus tracks.

There’s no subscription, no paywall, and no merch upsell. Just one donation, a full album, and real food on real tables.

Where your donation goes

We work with Kansas City partners to stretch every dollar further, focusing on the gaps other programs can’t always cover in time.

  • Fresh food delivered quickly — before it spoils on shelves.
  • Soft foods and essentials for unhoused neighbors.
  • Snacks and support for kids so they can focus on learning, not hunger.
  • Micro-grants and restocks for KC pantries and outreach teams.

One album. One city. One table at a time.
